[[File:Model8-XUnirail.jpg|thumb|250px|Model 8-X unirail]]
The '''Model 8-X Unirail''' was manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. 

If equipped with the standard fifteen cars, the train measured 320 meters long, carried ninety passengers per car, and held one metric ton of cargo.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The [[Bothan Colonial Board]] of [[Kothlis]] purchased three vehicles to serve two passenger lines of [["The Loop" (unirail)|"The Loop"]] in [[Tal'cara]], as well as a modified cargo line between the [[Kothlis Starport]] and the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]].<ref name="guide" />
